description: I05 review of keyword_docs catalog identifiers for which the provider returned no named field. Verdict labels only; no manual text.
reference: LS-DYNA R17 keyword manual, local private index (LSPP_MANUAL_INDEX), sections located with keyword_docs.manual_section

verdicts.no_data_card: The reviewed reference documents no input card for this identifier; an empty field list is correct.
verdicts.free_text: The only card is unstructured free text; there is no named field to index.
verdicts.provider_layout_missing: The reviewed reference documents named fields that the provider does not return; field coverage is incomplete.
verdicts.unconfirmed: The reviewed reference has no dedicated section for this identifier; neither verdict can be stated.

*CASE_BEGIN.note: Subcase ID is part of the keyword name (*CASE_BEGIN_n); the section's cards belong to *CASE.

*CASE_END.note: Subcase ID is part of the keyword name (*CASE_END_n); the section's cards belong to *CASE.

*CHANGE_RIGIDWALL_GEOMETRIC.note: Restart cards are documented as identical to *RIGIDWALL_GEOMETRIC.

*CHANGE_RIGIDWALL_PLANAR.note: Restart cards are documented as identical to *RIGIDWALL_PLANAR.

*CONTROL_EXPLOSIVE_SHADOW.note: Only the SET option adds a card; the base identifier has none.

*CONTROL_MPP_DECOMPOSITION_DISTRIBUTE_AL.note: The plural *..._ALE_ELEMENTS documents an optional card.

*INITIAL_STRAIN_SHELL.note: Provider's generated CardSet layout is empty.

*INITIAL_STRESS_SHELL.note: Provider's generated CardSet layout is empty.

*INTERFACE_SPG_1.note: Optional card (ISPGHIS); may postdate the provider's schema.

*INTERFACE_SPG_2.note: Optional card (ISPGHIS); may postdate the provider's schema.

*PARAMETER.note: Provider's SeriesCard returns no name/value layout.

*PARAMETER_LOCAL.note: Provider's SeriesCard returns no name/value layout.
